b: This hotfix focuses on stability and performance following our recent Update 1.5.1. Thanks for your ongoing feedback, Civ players!

A note for Switch / Switch 2 players: An additional hotfix with these changes and other Switch-specific fixes will be coming at a later date; thanks for your patience while we get this through additional Nintendo submission requirements. In the meantime, multiplayer and crossplay remains compatible with other platforms.
Saving a game to a Network Share no longer causes errors.
Addressed visual issues when hovering over DLC options on the Collections page.
Mods that add custom map sizes no longer cause the game to crash.
Addressed an issue where PlayStation players could not host multiplayer lobbies.
When playing with a controller, the minimap no longer disappears when returning from Settler Lens.

Specialist costs have been adjusted to scale slower per Age (2/3/4 instead of 2/4/6). This change was implemented in Update 1.5.1, but was missing in those patch notes.Dev Note: As we prepare for a fourth Age, we have been re-evaluating many of the per-Age costs in the game. Firaxis Feature Workshop participants will see many of these adjustments in the Workshop, but we felt this particular change would be an improvement to the current iteration of the game as well.
If you’re still running into issues after this patch, please let us know through our support portal.
